about_the_game:
ēvolūTiō is a captivating Tactical Strategy RPG that blends HD-2D pixel art with immersive 2.5D environments. Step into a city where identity is fluid, masks conceal truth, and evolution defines power.

In the labyrinthine city of Waglin, you awaken within a vast panopticon — a place of secrets, shifting allegiances, and hidden agendas. Guided by a rare evolutionary gift, uncover the truth behind your origin and the enigmatic figure Charlemagne, whose unseen influence binds the city’s fate.

Explore Waglin’s layered streets, unravel conspiracies through branching quests, and reshape the destiny of a world built on deception. Every decision, every transformation, and every battle creates lasting ripples through the city.

Key Features

🧬 The Power of Evolution

Harness the ability to shift between five distinct races, each altering how the world reacts, what paths open, and how battles unfold.
Slip past guards as a Pigfolk laborer, soar above ambushes as a Batkin, or adapt forms to overcome environmental challenges and tactical puzzles.

⚔️ Deep Tactical Combat

Every move matters. Movement and attacks draw from the same Action Point pool, rewarding foresight and precision. Manipulate terrain, trigger elemental effects, and evolve units through branching class paths with unique abilities and visuals.

🌍 A Living Renaissance World

Immerse yourself in a fantasy realm inspired by Renaissance Italy, rendered in a distinct HD-2D / 2.5D hybrid style. Explore intricate cityscapes, dynamic battlefields, and richly detailed architecture infused with magic and machinery.

👥 A Cast of Outcasts

Seven wandering souls — mercenaries, rebels, and seekers — drawn together by conflict and fate. Each carries personal motives, intertwining stories, and the power to alter Waglin’s balance.

🎲 Recruitable Unit Gacha

Expand your forces through a community-driven roster. Every Kickstarter-backed unit features original art, lore, and abilities — fully playable and integrated into the campaign.

🌗 Strategy Beyond the Battlefield

Accept contracts, manage resources, and navigate a web of intrigue. Choices echo across Waglin, changing alliances, access, and endings.

Peel Away the Masks.

Embrace the Shadows.

Evolve Beyond Form.

ēvolūTiō Tactics — where evolution is identity, and strategy is survival.
